observations: Public search returns source-specific watch URLs and pagination; no poster field
Category pages render initialResponse.items with posters and source IDs
Watch SSR contains full detail.episodes and episodeCount
VideoPlayer directly uses detail.episodes[index].url with HLS.js or native HLS; no extra proxy found in this player
The episode query is the one-based array ordinal; original episode name is preserved separately
limitations: Site serialization may change; data is parsed with a bounded literal grammar, never executed
Guest public data only; no login, AI parsing or quota rotation
Runtime only probes HLS playlists; MP4 returned without media download
Native iOS layout and full video decoding not tested
